text:
[Top illuminated panel - Surah title]
Surah Al-An'am (The Cattle)

[Main Quranic Text]
In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
All praise is due to God, who created the heavens and the earth and
made darkness and light; yet those who deny the truth
hold others as equal to their Lord. It is He who created you from
clay, then decreed a term, and a specified term is fixed with Him; yet
you continue to doubt. And He is God in the heavens and on
the earth; He knows your secrets and your open deeds, and He knows
what you earn. No sign comes to them from the signs of
their Lord but that they turn away from it. They have denied the truth when it came to them; soon there will come to them the news of what they used to
mock.

They mock. Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them — generations We had established in the land in ways We have not established you — and We sent the sky upon them in abundant rain and made rivers flow beneath them, yet We destroyed them for their sins and raised up other generations after them.

And if We had sent down to you a written scripture on parchment and they touched it with their own hands, those who disbelieve would still say: "This is nothing but clear sorcery."

And they say: "Why has an angel not been sent down to him?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided and they would not be given any respite.

And if We had made the messenger an angel, We would have made him appear as a man, and We would have obscured for them what they are already obscuring.

And messengers before you were certainly mocked, but those who ridiculed them were overtaken by the very thing they used to mock.

Say: Travel through the earth and then observe what was the end of those who denied the truth. Say: To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth? Say: To God. He has decreed mercy upon Himself. He will surely gather you on the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who have lost their souls — they do not believe.
To Him belongs whatever dwells in the night and the day, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Say: Shall I take as a guardian anyone other than God, the Originator of the heavens and the earth? And it is He who feeds and is not fed. Say: I have been commanded to be the first of those who submit, and do not be among the polytheists. Say: Indeed, I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.
Whoever is spared from it on that Day — God has truly shown him mercy, and that is the clear triumph. And if there touches you —

Allah with harm, there is none to remove it except Him. And if He touches you with good, then He is over all things competent. And He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Wise, the Acquainted. Say: What thing is greatest in testimony? Say: Allah is witness between me and you. And this Quran was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whoever it reaches. Do you truly testify that with Allah there are other gods? Say: I will not testify. Say: He is but one God, and indeed I am free of what you associate with Him. Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize him as they recognize their own sons. Those who have lost themselves do not believe. And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed. And the Day We gather them all together, then We will say to those who associated others with Allah: Where are your alleged partners

Those whom you used to claim [as intercessors]. Then their only excuse when they were tried was that they said: "By God, our Lord, we were not polytheists."
See how they lied against themselves, and how that which they used to fabricate has abandoned them.
And among them are those who listen to you, yet We have placed coverings over their hearts, lest they understand it, and deafness in their ears. Even if they were to see every sign, they would not believe in it. When they come to you to dispute with you, those who disbelieve say: "This is nothing but legends of the ancients."
And they forbid others from it and keep away from it. They destroy none but themselves, though they do not perceive it.
If you could only see when they are made to stand before the Fire, and they say: "Oh, would that we could be returned! Then we would not deny the signs of our Lord, and we would be among the believers."

Indeed, what they used to conceal before has become apparent to them. And if they were returned, they would go back to what they were forbidden, for they are truly liars.
And they say, "There is nothing but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
And if you could see when they are made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
Those who denied the meeting with God have truly lost. When the Hour comes upon them suddenly, they will say, "Alas, how great is our regret over what we neglected in it!" And they will carry their burdens on their backs. Evil indeed is what they carry.
The life of this world is nothing but play and amusement, and the home of the Hereafter is far better for those who are mindful of God. Will you not then understand?
We know indeed that what they say grieves you.

For indeed, it is not you they deny — but it is the wrongdoers who reject the signs of God. Messengers before you were also denied, yet they endured patiently what they were denied and harmed, until Our help came to them. There is no one who can alter the words of God, and there has already come to you some of the news of the messengers. And if their turning away is hard upon you — then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a ladder into the sky to bring them a sign — but had God willed, He would have gathered them all upon guidance, so do not be among the ignorant. Only those who hear will respond; as for the dead, God will resurrect them, then to Him they will be returned. And they say: "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say: Indeed, God is able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know. There is no creature on earth, nor a bird

— flies on its two wings, but they are communities like yourselves. We have neglected nothing in the Book; then to their Lord they will be gathered.
Those who deny Our signs are deaf and dumb, lost in darkness. Whoever Allah wills, He leaves to stray, and whoever He wills, He places on a straight path.
Say: "Have you considered — if the punishment of Allah comes to you, or the Hour overtakes you, will you call upon anyone other than Allah, if you are truthful?"
No — it is Him alone you will call upon, and He will remove whatever distress prompted your call, if He wills; and you will forget whatever you used to associate with Him.
We have sent messengers to communities before you, and We seized them with hardship and affliction so that they might humble themselves.
If only, when Our punishment reached them, they had humbled themselves! But their hearts hardened, and Satan made their deeds seem fair to them.
Then, when they forgot what they had been reminded of —

...that they were reminded of, We opened for them the gates of everything, until when they rejoiced in what they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were left in despair. So the last remnant of the people who did wrong was cut off. And praise be to God, Lord of all the worlds. Say: Have you considered — if God were to take away your hearing and your sight and seal your hearts — who is a god other than God who could restore it to you? See how We vary the signs, yet still they turn away. Say: Have you considered — if the punishment of God should come upon you suddenly or openly — would any be destroyed except the wrongdoing people? We send the messengers only as bearers of good news and as warners. So whoever believes and reforms — there shall be no fear upon them, nor shall they grieve. But those who deny Our signs — the punishment will touch them because of what they used to do in defiance. Say: No...

Say: "I do not tell you that I possess the treasures of God, nor do I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I follow only what is revealed to me." Say: "Are the blind and the seeing equal? Will you not then reflect?"
And warn by it those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord, having no protector or intercessor besides Him, so that they may be mindful.
And do not drive away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His face. You are not accountable for them in anything, nor are they accountable for you in anything, that you should drive them away and thus become one of the wrongdoers.
And thus We have tried some of them by others, so that they say: "Are these the ones whom God has favored among us?" Is God not most knowing of those who are grateful?
And when those who believe in Our signs come to you, say: ...

Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed mercy upon Himself: that whoever among you commits evil out of ignorance and then repents thereafter and reforms — then He is Forgiving, Merciful. And thus do We detail the verses, and so that the way of the criminals may become evident.
Say: I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God. Say: I will not follow your desires, for then I would have gone astray and would not be among the rightly guided.
Say: I stand upon clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have what you seek to hasten. Judgment belongs to none but God; He declares the truth, and He is the best of arbiters.
Say: If I had what you seek to hasten, the matter would have been decided between me and you. But God knows best who the wrongdoers are.
With Him are the keys of the unseen — none knows them but He. And He knows what is in the land and

And the sea — not a leaf falls but He knows it, and there is no grain in the darkness of the earth, nor anything moist or dry, but it is recorded in a clear Book. He is the One who takes your souls by night and knows what you do by day, then He raises you up in it so that an appointed term may be fulfilled; then to Him is your return, and then He will inform you of what you used to do. He is the Irresistible, above His servants, and He sends guardians over you until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take his soul, and they do not fall short. Then they are returned to Allah, their true Master. Surely His is the judgment, and He is the swiftest of reckoners. Say: Who saves you from the darknesses of land and sea? You call upon Him humbly and secretly: "If He saves us from this, we will surely be among the grateful." Say: Allah

He rescues you from it and from every distress, yet you associate partners with Him.
Say: "He is the One who has the power to send upon you punishment from above you or from beneath your feet, or to confuse you into factions and make some of you taste the violence of others."
See how We explain the signs in various ways, so that they may understand.
Your people have rejected it, though it is the truth. Say: "I am not a guardian over you. For every prophecy there is an appointed time, and you will come to know."
And when you see those who engage in mockery of Our signs, turn away from them until they engage in a different conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not sit, after the reminder, with the wrongdoing people.
Those who are mindful of God bear no responsibility for the others' account — it is only a reminder, so that perhaps they may be mindful.
And leave...

Those who took their religion as amusement and play, and were deluded by the life of this world. So remind with it, lest a soul be destroyed for what it has earned; it will have no protector or intercessor besides God, and even if it offers every compensation, none will be accepted from it. Those are the ones who are destroyed for what they earned; they will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because of what they used to deny.

Say: "Shall we call upon, instead of God, what neither benefits us nor harms us, and be turned back on our heels after God has guided us? — like one whom the devils have lured away in the earth, bewildered, while he has companions calling him to guidance: 'Come to us.'" Say: "Indeed, the guidance of God is the true guidance, and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all the worlds,

And to establish prayer and to be mindful of Him, and it is He to Whom you will be gathered." And He

He saves you from it and from every distress, yet you associate partners with Him.
Say: He is able to send upon you punishment from above you or from beneath your feet, or to confuse you in factions and make you taste the violence of one another.
See how We present the signs in various ways, so that they may understand.
Your people have denied it, though it is the truth. Say: I am not a guardian over you.
For every prophecy there is a fixed time, and you will come to know.
When you see those who mock Our signs, turn away from them until they engage in different talk.
And if Satan causes you to forget, then after the reminder do not sit with the wrongdoing people.
Those who are mindful of God bear no responsibility for the wrongdoers' account — it is only a reminder, so that they may be mindful.
And leave —

He who created the heavens and the earth in truth, and on the day He says "Be," and it is. His word is the truth, and His is the dominion on the day the trumpet is blown — the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He is the Wise, the All-Aware. And when Abraham said to his father Azar: "Do you take idols as gods? I see you and your people in manifest error." And thus We showed Abraham the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, so that he might be among those who are certain. When the night darkened over him, he saw a star and said: "This is my Lord." But when it set, he said: "I do not love those that set." When he saw the moon rising, he said: "This is my Lord." But when it set, he said: "If my Lord does not guide me, I will surely be among the people who are astray." When he saw the sun rising, he said: "This is my Lord — this is greater." But when it set,

He said: "O my people, I am free of what you associate with God.
I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and
the earth, as a true believer, and I am not of those who associate partners with God."
His people argued with him. He said: "Do you argue with me concerning God, when He has guided me? I do not fear what you associate with Him, unless my Lord wills something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge.
Will you not then remember? And how should I fear what you have associated with God, when you do not fear that you have associated with God
that for which He has sent down to you no authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you only knew?
It is those who believe and do not mix their faith with wrongdoing — for them there is security, and they are rightly guided.
And that was Our argument which We gave to
Abraham against his people. We raise in degrees whom We will."

Indeed, your Lord is Wise and All-Knowing. And We gave him Isaac and Jacob — all of them We guided — and Noah We guided before, and among his descendants: David, Solomon,
Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron — and thus do We reward those who do good — and Zechariah, John, Jesus, and Elias — each one of them was among the righteous — and Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot — and each one of them We preferred above all people — and among their fathers, their descendants, and their brothers. We chose them and guided them to a straight path. That is the guidance of God; He guides with it whoever He wills among His servants. But if they had associated partners with Him, what they used to do would have been nullified for them. Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and sound judgment

and prophethood — if these people disbelieve in it, We have entrusted it to a people who do not disbelieve in it. Those are the ones whom God has guided, so follow their guidance. Say: I ask of you no reward for it; it is nothing but a reminder for all the worlds. They did not appraise God with true appraisal when they said: God has not revealed anything to any human being. Say: Who then revealed the Book that Moses brought — a light and guidance for people — which you have put on separate sheets, showing some and concealing much? And you were taught what neither you nor your forefathers knew. Say: God. Then leave them to play in their vain discourse. And this is a blessed Book that We have sent down, confirming what came before it, so that you may warn the Mother of Cities and all those around it. And those who believe in the Hereafter

They believe in it, and they are diligent in their prayers.
And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about God, or says, "Revelation has come to me," when nothing has been revealed to him, or one who says, "I will reveal the like of what God has revealed"? If only you could see the wrongdoers in the throes of death, while the angels stretch out their hands: "Give up your souls! Today you will be repaid with a humiliating punishment for what you used to say falsely about God, and for being arrogant toward His signs."
And now you have come to Us alone, just as We created you the first time, and you have left behind everything We bestowed upon you. And We do not see with you your intercessors — those whom you claimed were partners in your affairs. The bond between you has been severed, and what you used to claim has failed you. Indeed, God...

When they see it drawing near, the faces of those who disbelieved will be distressed, and it will be said: "This is what you used to call for."

Say: "Have you considered: whether God destroys me and those with me, or has mercy on us — who then can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

Say: "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and in Him we have placed our trust. You will soon know who is in clear error."

Say: "Have you considered: if your water were to sink away into the earth, who then could bring you flowing water?"

Surah An-Naba' • Ma'in • [Completion of the Surah]

In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
About what are they asking one another? About the great news —
the matter over which they differ. No indeed, they will soon come to know. Then no indeed, they will soon come to know. Did We not make the earth

[margin: The Part (Juz')]

Blazing light, and the mountains as pegs, and We created you in pairs, and We made your sleep for rest, and We made the night as a covering, and We made the day for livelihood, and We built above you seven strong heavens, and We made a blazing lamp, and We sent down from the rain-laden clouds pouring water, that We may bring forth grain and vegetation, and gardens of dense growth. Indeed, the Day of Judgment is an appointed time — the Day the trumpet is blown and you come in crowds, and the sky is opened and becomes gates, and the mountains are set in motion and become a mirage. Indeed, Hell is lying in wait — a destination for the transgressors, in which they will remain for ages, tasting therein neither coolness nor any drink, except scalding water.

[Upper Quranic Text - Surah Al-An'am, end]

No soul bearing a burden bears the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of that over which you used to differ. And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees of rank, that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

[Golden Illuminated Panel]
Surah Ya-Sin, thirty-three verses

[Lower Quranic Text - Surah Ya-Sin, opening]
In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

Ya-Sin. By the wise Quran. Indeed you are among the messengers, on a straight path. This is a revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful, that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless. The word has already been proven true against most of them, so they do not believe. Indeed, We have placed

They are nothing but a fabrication, and the Most Merciful has not sent down anything — you are only lying.
They said: Our Lord knows that we are truly sent to you.
And our duty is only to deliver the clear message.
They said: We see an evil omen in you. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.
They said: Your evil omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? No, but you are a people who transgress all bounds.
And there came a man running from the farthest part of the city. He said: O my people, follow the messengers!
Follow those who ask you no reward and who are rightly guided.
And why should I not worship Him who created me and to whom you will be returned?
Should I take others besides Him as gods? If the Most Merciful intends any harm for me, their intercession cannot help me at all, nor can they save me.
Then truly I would be in clear error.
Indeed I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.
It was said: Enter Paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
How my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored ones.
And We did not send down upon his people after him any host from heaven, nor were We to send any.

A single blast, and at once they are extinguished. What a regret for the servants — no messenger comes to them but they mock him. Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, who do not return to them? And every single one of them will be brought before Us. A sign for them is the dead earth: We revive it and bring forth from it grain, from which they eat. And We placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines.

Main Text (Quran, Surah Ya-Sin 36:34-43):

And [We placed in it] vineyards, and We caused springs to gush forth within it, so that they might eat from its fruits, though their own hands did not make it. Will they not then give thanks?

Glory be to Him who created all pairs — of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.

And a sign for them is the night: We strip from it the day, and they are left in darkness.

And the sun runs to its resting place — that is the decree of the Almighty, the All-Knowing. And the moon — We have measured out its phases until it returns like an old withered date-stalk.

It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outpace the day. Each floats in its own orbit.

And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship.

And We created for them the like of it, on which they ride.

And if We will, We drown them — and there is no rescuer for them.

And they will not be saved — except as a mercy from Us and enjoyment for a time. And when it is said to them, "Spend from what is before you and what is behind you, that perhaps you may be shown mercy." And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord but that they turn away from it. And when it is said to them, "Spend from what Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error." And they say, "When is this promise, if you are truthful?" They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing. And they will not be able to make a bequest, nor to their people will they return. And the trumpet will be blown, and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us from our resting place?" This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth.
It will be nothing but a single blast, and at once they will all be brought before Us.
So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
Indeed the companions of Paradise, on that Day, will be joyfully occupied.
They and their spouses will be in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
They will have fruits therein, and they will have whatever they call for.
"Peace" — a word from a Merciful Lord.
And [it will be said]: "Stand apart today, you criminals!
Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you should not worship Satan — for he is a clear enemy to you —
And that you should worship Me? This is a straight path.
And yet he led astray from among you a great multitude—

Many — did they not use their reason? This is Hell, which you were promised. Enter it today for what you used to deny. Today We seal their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to what they used to earn. And if We willed, We could have blotted out their eyes, and they would race to find the path — but how would they see? And if We willed, We could have transformed them in their places, so they would not be able to move forward or turn back. And whoever We grant long life, We cause him to decline in power — will they not then understand? We did not teach him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is nothing but a Reminder and a clear Quran, to warn whoever is alive, and that the word may be proved against the disbelievers. Do they not see that We created for them, from what Our hands have made, livestock —

And they are its owners. And We have tamed them for them, so some they ride and some they eat. And they have in them benefits and drinks — will they not then be grateful?
Yet they have taken gods besides God, hoping they might be helped. Those gods cannot help them, though they stand as an army ready for them. So do not let their words grieve you; We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
Does not the human being see that We created him from a drop of fluid, and then he becomes an open adversary? And he strikes a comparison for Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones after they have decayed?" Say: He who created them the first time will give them life, for He has knowledge of every created thing — He who made for you from the green tree

[End of Surah Ya-Sin]

"And you kindle fire from it. Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the likes of them? Yes, indeed! And He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing. His command, when He wills a thing, is only to say to it 'Be!' and it is. So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of all things, and to Him you will be returned."

[Chapter Heading]
Surah Al-Fath (The Victory) — Meccan — Twenty-nine verses

[Beginning of Surah Al-Fath]

In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

"Indeed, We have granted you a clear victory, so that God may forgive you your past and future sins, complete His favor upon you, and guide you to a straight path, and so that God may grant you a mighty triumph. He is the One who..."

He sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers so that they would increase in faith along with their existing faith. To God belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise. He will admit the believing men and believing women into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to remain there forever, and He will absolve them of their sins — and that, in the sight of God, is the supreme triumph. And He will punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women, those who harbor evil thoughts about God. The evil turn of fortune is upon them. God's wrath is upon them; He has cursed them and prepared Hell for them — a wretched destination. To God belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and God is Almighty, All-Wise. We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner, so that you may believe in God

There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick. And whoever obeys God and His Messenger, He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away, He will punish him with a painful punishment.

God was well pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent victory,

And abundant spoils that they would take. God is Mighty, Wise. God has promised you many spoils that you will take, and He hastened these for you and held back the hands of people from you — so that it may be a sign for the believers and that He may guide you to a straight path. And other gains which you were not able to achieve — God has already encompassed them. And God...

Allah has power over all things. And if those who disbelieved had fought you, they would have turned their backs, and then they would have found neither protector nor helper. Such has been the way of Allah that has passed before, and you will never find any change in the way of Allah. And it is He who held back their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Mecca, after He had granted you victory over them. And Allah is ever Seeing of what you do. They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and prevented the sacrificial animals from reaching their place of slaughter. And had it not been for believing men and believing women whom you did not know — that you might have trampled them, and thus incurred guilt on their account without your knowledge — so that Allah may admit to His mercy whom He wills. Had they been apart, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with a painful punishment.

When those who disbelieved placed in their hearts the fierce loyalty — the fierce loyalty of ignorance — Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and committed them to the word of piety, for they were most deserving of it and worthy of it. And Allah is, of all things, Knowing. Allah has fulfilled for His Messenger the vision in truth: You will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and hair shortened, not fearing. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a near victory. He is the One who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness. Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, seeking bounty from

of Allah and His pleasure. The mark of them is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah; and their description in the Gospel is like a seed which sends forth its shoot and strengthens it, and it becomes thick and stands upon its stem, delighting the sowers, so that He may enrage the disbelievers by them. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous deeds
forgiveness and a great reward.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Blessed is He in Whose hand is the dominion, and He is over all things
Who created death and life that He may test you
as to which of you is best in deed. And He is the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.
Who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in

...of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return your vision — do you see any breaks?
Then return your vision twice again; your sight will return to you humbled and exhausted.
And We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them as missiles against the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a roaring while it boils up,
It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them: "Did there not come to you a warner?"
They said: "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said: Allah has not revealed anything — you are not but in great error."
And they said: "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

the Blaze. So they will confess their sins — but away with the companions of the Blaze! Indeed, those who fear their Lord in secret will have forgiveness and a great reward. Whether you speak in secret or aloud — He certainly knows what is in the hearts. Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted? It is He who made the earth tame for you, so walk along its slopes and eat of His provision — and to Him is the resurrection. Do you feel secure that He who is above the heavens will not cause the earth to swallow you up, when it begins to tremble? Or do you feel secure that He who is above the heavens will not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how severe My warning was. And those before them had already denied — so how terrible was My reproach! Have they not looked at the birds above them,

Spreading their wings and drawing them in — none holds them up except the Most Merciful. He is All-Seeing of everything. Or who is it that could be an army for you to help you against the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion. Or who is it that could provide for you if He were to withhold His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion. Is one who walks fallen on his face better guided, or one who walks upright on a straight path? Say: It is He who created you and made for you hearing, sight, and hearts — yet little do you give thanks. Say: It is He who has dispersed you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered. And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful? Say: Knowledge of it is only with God, and I am only a clear warner.

Cleaver of grain and date-stones, He brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from the living. That is God — so how are you deluded?
Cleaver of the dawn, He has made the night for rest, and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the measure set by the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
And He it is who has set the stars for you, so that you may be guided by them in the darkness of land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know. ۞ And He it is who has produced you from a single soul, and there is a dwelling-place and a temporary repository. We have detailed the signs for a people who understand. ۞ And He it is who sends down water from the sky, and with it We bring forth vegetation of every kind, and from it We bring forth green growth, from which We bring forth grain piled up in layers, and from the date-palm, from its spathe, clusters of dates hanging low, and gardens of grapes, and olives, and

and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Look at their fruit when they begin to bear fruit and at their ripening. Surely in that are signs for people who believe.
Yet they have made the jinn partners with God, though He created them, and they have falsely attributed to Him sons and daughters without any knowledge. Glory be to Him, and exalted is He above what they ascribe.
He is the Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a child when He has no consort, and He created all things, and He has full knowledge of all things?
That is God, your Lord. There is no god but He, the Creator of all things, so worship Him, for He is the Guardian over all things.
Vision cannot encompass Him, but He encompasses all vision, and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.
Clear proofs have come to you from your Lord. Whoever sees clearly, it is for his own soul, and whoever is blind, it is against it. And I am not a guardian over you.
And thus...

We vary the signs so that they say, "You have studied," and so that We may make it clear to a people who know. Follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord — there is no god but He — and turn away from the polytheists. Had God willed, they would not have associated partners with Him. We have not made you a keeper over them, nor are you a guardian over them. Do not revile those whom they call upon besides God, lest they revile God in hostility without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every nation their deeds; then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them of what they used to do. They swear by God with their most solemn oaths that if a sign comes to them, they will surely believe in it. Say: Signs are only with God. And what will make you realize that even if a sign came, they would not believe? And We turn their hearts and their eyes, just as they did not believe in it the first time.

And We leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly. And even if We had sent down angels to them, and the dead had spoken to them, and We had gathered all things before them, they would not have believed unless God willed — but most of them are ignorant. And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy: devils among humankind and jinn, inspiring one another with flowery speech as delusion. Had your Lord willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and what they fabricate. And so that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may incline toward it, and that they may be pleased with it, and that they may commit what they are going to commit. Shall I seek other than God as a judge, when it is He who has sent down to you the Book explained in detail? Those to whom We gave the Scripture know that it is revealed from your Lord in truth, so do not be among those who doubt.

The word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and justice. No one can change His words, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. If you were to obey most of those on earth, they would lead you away from the path of God. They follow nothing but conjecture, and they do nothing but guess.
Indeed, your Lord knows best who strays from His path, and He knows best those who are rightly guided. So eat of that over which the name of God has been mentioned, if you believe in His signs.
And why should you not eat of that over which the name of God has been mentioned, when He has already explained to you what He has forbidden you — except when you are forced by necessity? Indeed, many lead others astray by their own desires without knowledge. Truly, your Lord knows best those who transgress.
Leave all sin, open and secret. Indeed, those who commit sin will be repaid

...for what they used to commit. Do not eat of that over which the name of God has not been mentioned, for that is indeed sinfulness. The devils inspire their allies to argue with you; and if you obey them, you will indeed be associating partners with God. Is he who was dead and whom We brought to life, and made for him a light by which he walks among the people, like one whose likeness is in darkness from which he cannot emerge? Thus is made appealing to the disbelievers what they used to do. And thus We have placed in every city the greatest of its criminals to scheme therein. But they scheme only against themselves, and they do not perceive it. And when a sign comes to them, they say: "We will never believe until we are given the like of what was given to God's messengers." God knows best where to place His message. Those who committed crimes will be afflicted...

And on the Day He gathers them all together: "O assembly of jinn, you have truly exploited many of mankind." The All-Wise, the All-Knowing. And thus We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others because of what they used to earn. They will say: We bear witness against ourselves. And the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers. This is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware. And for all there are degrees according to what they have done, and your Lord is not unaware of what they do. And your Lord is the Self-Sufficient, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with you and give succession after you to whoever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people. Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not be able to escape it. He said:

O my people, act according to your position; indeed, I am acting. You will come to know who will have the good end of this world's abode. Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.

And they assigned to Allah, from what He created of crops and livestock, a share and said, "This is for Allah," by their claim, "and this is for our partners." But what was for their partners did not reach Allah, while what was for Allah did reach their partners. Evil is how they judged.

And likewise, to many of the polytheists, their partners have made the killing of their children seem pleasing, in order to ruin them and to confuse their religion for them. And if Allah had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and what they invent.

And they said, "These are livestock and crops that are forbidden — no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are livestock whose backs are forbidden, and livestock

They do not mention the name of God over them, fabricating lies against Him. He will repay them for what they used to fabricate. And they say: "What is in the wombs of these cattle is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our wives; but if it is stillborn, they all share in it." He will repay them for their attribution — indeed, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Those who killed their children foolishly, without knowledge, and forbade what God had provided for them, fabricating lies against God — they have truly lost. They went astray and were not rightly guided.
And it is He who produced gardens, both trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of varying produce, and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of their fruit when they bear fruit, and give its due on the day of harvest, and do not be wasteful — indeed, He

He does not love the extravagant. And of the livestock are those for carrying loads and those close to the ground. Eat of what God has provided for you, and do not follow in the footsteps of Satan — he is a clear enemy to you.
Eight pairs: two of sheep and two of goats. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you are truthful."
And two of camels and two of cattle. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when God gave you this commandment?" Who is more unjust than one who fabricates a lie against God in order to lead people astray without knowledge? Indeed, God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
Say, "I do not find..."

"Say: I do not find in what has been revealed to me anything forbidden to one who wishes to eat it, unless it be carrion, or blood poured forth, or the flesh of swine — for that is indeed an abomination — or that which has been slaughtered impiously, dedicated to other than God. But whoever is compelled by necessity, neither desiring nor transgressing — your Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

And to those who followed Judaism We forbade every animal with claws, and of cattle and sheep We forbade them their fat, except what their backs carried, or the entrails, or what is mixed with bone. That is how We repaid them for their transgression, and We are indeed truthful.

If they deny you, say: Your Lord is possessed of vast mercy, yet His punishment cannot be averted from the guilty people.

Thus did those before them deny, until they tasted Our punishment. Say: "Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow nothing but conjecture, and you are only guessing."
Say: "To God belongs the conclusive argument. Had He willed, He would have guided you all."
Say: "Bring your witnesses who will testify that God has forbidden this." If they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our signs, and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, and who equate others with their Lord.
Say: "Come, I will recite what your Lord has forbidden you: that you associate nothing with Him, and that you be good to your parents, and that you do not kill your children out of poverty — We provide for you and for them — and do not approach indecencies, whether open or secret, and do not kill the soul

...that which Allah has forbidden, except by right. This He has enjoined upon you so that you may use reason. And do not approach the wealth of the orphan except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and full weight in justice. We do not burden a soul beyond that which it can bear. And when you speak, be just, even if it concerns a close relative. And fulfill the covenant of Allah. This He has enjoined upon you so that you may remember.
And that this is My straight path, so follow it; and do not follow other ways, for they will separate you from His way. This He has enjoined upon you so that you may become righteous.
Then We gave Moses the Scripture, complete for whoever would do good, and as a detailed explanation of all things, and as guidance and mercy, so that they might believe in the meeting with their Lord.

And this...

And this is a Book We have revealed, blessed, so follow it and fear God so that you may receive mercy. [This was revealed] lest you say: "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, and we were indeed unaware of their study." Or lest you say: "If only the Scripture had been sent down to us, we would have been better guided than they." Now there has come to you a clear proof from your Lord, and guidance and mercy. Who then is more unjust than one who rejects the signs of God and turns away from them? We will repay those who turn away from Our signs with the worst punishment for their turning away. Are they waiting only for the angels to come to them, or for your Lord Himself to come, or for some of your Lord's signs to come? On the Day when some of your Lord's signs arrive, belief will not benefit a soul that did not believe before, or that did not earn good through its faith.

What follows is a description of the Declaration of Faith (Iman):
I believe in Allah, and in His angels, and in His scriptures, and in His messengers, and in the Last Day, and in divine decree — both its good and its evil — as coming from Allah the Exalted.

And the word of testimony — the remembrance of You is obligatory upon me.
It is necessary — to glorify You in Your might, and
to present it to all the world — and all of my body
must do so — Your remembrance is forever obligatory upon me.
It is incumbent — that which draws near to You, to rise up
and the direction within my heart facing toward Your Presence
to rise — and to find the summit of that union
to acknowledge the Messiah in that gathering — and to turn my face toward obedience
to that rising — fulfilling Your remembrance is obligatory upon me.
There are two — the most distinguished among those who do not fear death:
to acknowledge — and those who travel along its elevated path,
forever establishing the way of the Messiah, following it forever,
repeating its benefit again and again — that is the one who follows it truly.

Taking ablution is to wipe over the two boots — this is called striking twice. As for the prayer (Namaz):
Its obligatory elements (fards) are twelve: six are internal and six are external. The internal ones are pillars (rukun), while the external ones are conditions (shurut). Its conditions are: purity from ritual impurity (hadath), purity of the body, covering the nakedness (awrah), facing the qibla, knowing the proper time, and having intention (niyyah). Its pillars (arkans) are: the opening takbir, standing (qiyam), recitation (qira'at), bowing (ruku'), prostration (sujud), and the sitting position for the duration of the tashahhud, to the extent that is prescribed and measured.

And the total number of the obligatory duties that we can see
is thirty-two. And knowing them
is an obligation upon us. — Du'a (Prayer) of the Adhan —

O Allah, provide me with the two things.

grant Muhammad the intercession and the favor and the elevated
rank, and raise him to the praiseworthy station
that You have promised him. Indeed, You do not break Your promise.
